method.title: Connect your charger
method.description: Retrieve a connection key using Mi Home, or enter an existing key. The key is used for local Bluetooth access.

cloud_region.title: Xiaomi account region
cloud_region.description: Choose the region selected in your Mi Home app settings.

![QR code]({qr_url})

cloud_error.title: Retry Mi Home connection
cloud_error.description: Follow the guidance below, then try again.

token.title: Connect {name}
token.description: Enter the 24-character hexadecimal Bluetooth key for this charger. The connection will be verified before saving. You can also go back and choose Mi Home sign-in.

data_description.update_period: The charger normally pushes live updates. This interval controls fallback reads of the full state.

advanced.title: Advanced connection settings
advanced.description: Defaults normally work. Adjust these settings when troubleshooting or sharing the charger with Mi Home.

data_description.idle_release: Release Bluetooth this long after connecting or controlling the charger. Set to 0 to keep the connection. Later refreshes reconnect; this does not pause the integration.
data_description.connection_timeout: How long to wait for a Bluetooth connection.
data_description.bluez_start_notify: A workaround for Bluetooth notification problems on Linux. Usually unnecessary with remote Bluetooth proxies.
